_comment: Run matrix for reproduce.py (resumable: each block writes results/parts/<block>.json; the parts are merged into results/results.json). Geometry of the reference building is in building.json; physics in parameters.json. main_envelope: the building studied (SBC-compliant); the other envelope serves only as the pre-code comparison.

precool_grid._note: Pre-cooling depths realisable on a thermostat with 0.5 K steps (night window and pre-peak window); the 7 x 7 lattice (49 distinct policies, including no pre-cooling) is searched exhaustively. The deepest depth, 3 K from the 23.5 degC reference, puts the setpoint at 20.5 degC, so with the 0.5 K switching margin no room falls below the 20 degC floor of the safe set.

internal_gain_sweep._note: annual-mean internal gain [W/m2]; the last value is the previous (un-sourced) 21 W/m2 assumption, kept as an extreme upper bound

dawn_setback._note: Pre-specified dawn setback (cooling months): the cooling setpoint is lowered by depth_K at start_h and returned to the setpoint in 0.5 K thermostat steps by end_h.

right_sizing._note: Units sized to each zone's largest hourly sensible load at the reference setpoint (typical year), times a margin, rounded up to 0.25 ton (minimum 0.75 ton). The comfort-equivalent margin is the first of `margins`, tried in increasing order, at which no room leaves the safe set (no excursion above 24 degC); `curve_margins` give the excursion-margin curve with the base controller and with a full-capacity start; `tight_margin` gives the hard test instances.

uncertainty._note: Latin hypercube over the assumed inputs of reproduce.UQ_PARAMS (uniform ranges), SBC-compliant building, Case 3, sampled year; outputs per city; PRCC by rank regression.
